name: Concordance down-weights chronic disagreement, never bans
non_visual_rationale: A weight is invisible by design; its only trace is how far a stored number moved. No template, string, style or route is touched, and at launch the observation log is empty. U1-U8 and a Vera walk are N/A.
criteria_delivered: 1. w_r = clip(tau_w / (tau_w + D_r), 0.2, 1.0), tau_w = 4, D_r in sigma_eff^2 units against co-observed spot-day medians, shrunk toward the population mean when co-observations are few. The units are pinned by an example (a reporter off by sqrt(tau_w) sigma every morning keeps exactly half a voice) and the shrink's own strength by a second (one co-observed morning two sigma out is weighed at exactly 0.6).

2. A device disagreeing every morning moves the stored difference under six tenths of full trust and above one twentieth -- and the stored number lands strictly BETWEEN what their absence leaves and what believing them outright would reach, so a sign flip or an overshoot inside the corridor cannot pass.

3. A newcomer's identical morning weighs exactly a familiar reporter's, to the last digit: no newcomer discount exists anywhere. Held separately at the unit layer, where a reporter nobody has ever reported alongside must keep a full voice EVEN WHEN the community around them disagrees loudly -- the branch a fixture with an agreeing community cannot see.

4. CONSEQUENCE, DEMONSTRATED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: because concordance reads post-fence values, the day fence bounds D_r, and the 0.2 floor is therefore unreachable by anyone whose mornings had three witnesses. The roadmap asserts this; this step's fixtures show it -- the chronic liar in the acceptance file lands near 0.28, not on the floor, and the floor is exercised at the unit layer by a deliberately drawn world the fence never touched.
scope_note: The accepted roadmap names weights.ts and the unit laws. Four more files were touched and had to be. constants.ts: tau_w, the floor, the ceiling and the shrink's strength are declared numbers and this repo keeps declared numbers in one home. residuals.ts: the sample now carries reporter_key (06 section 4's C5 resolution) and its own sigma_eff, because a disagreement measured in units of sigma_eff^2 cannot be computed without them. correction-file.ts: THE STRUCTURAL CHANGE OF THIS STEP -- see the design decision below. a-wild-claim-is-pulled-to-the-day-fence.test.ts: 04-02's below-three oracle stopped being sound the moment a second day-sensitive stage existed; the repair is recorded in test_repair.
design_decisions_not_stated_upstream: THE FIT NOW WEIGHS IN TWO MOVEMENTS, and correction-file.ts was restructured to say so. Steps 1 and 2 of 06 section 6.2 are local to a key and still run there. Step 3 is not: a reporter's record spans every spot and every key the run examined, so it cannot be measured inside a per-key loop. Every key's samples are therefore collapsed and fenced FIRST and held in that weighed-but-unaveraged state; concordance is then measured once over all of them; only then is anything averaged. estimateOf no longer runs the weighing room -- it consumes a finished list, which is what it always claimed to be.

DISAGREEMENT IS MEASURED AGAINST THE OTHER REPORTERS' MEDIAN, NOT THE WHOLE MORNING'S. 06 section 6.2 step 3 says 'co-observed spot-day medians' without saying whether the reporter is inside their own comparison. Research 09 section 13.5c, which is where the rule comes from, settles it: weigh a reporter by how well their reports 'agreed with the consensus of OTHER reporters at the same spot/time'. Reading it the other way is not merely looser, it is broken -- on a two-report morning the median IS one of the two reports, so one of the two measures a disagreement of zero with themselves and the louder half of every disagreeing pair goes unmeasured. A property now forbids exactly that, and mutation P3 confirms it fires.

CONCORDANCE IS MEASURED WITHIN A KEY, never across sources. Two residuals at the same key on the same morning differ by exactly what the two people reported; two residuals at different sources differ by two forecasts as well, so comparing them would score a reporter on which model was handed to them. The argument to the port is therefore a list of keys, not a flat list of samples.

THE SCORE LANE PARTICIPATES, on the same footing, because the sample carries its own sigma_eff. A disagreement about how good a morning was is still a disagreement, and dividing by each lane's own sigma_eff is exactly what 'in units of sigma_eff^2' buys: the two lanes become comparable and one reporter has one voice everywhere rather than two.

THE SHRINK'S STRENGTH IS ITS OWN DECLARED CONSTANT, CONCORDANCE_PRIOR_OBSERVATIONS = 1, NOT tau_w REUSED. 06 section 6.2 step 3 asks for the shrink and names no strength. Read as a number of prior observations, the population mean counts as ONE morning of evidence about a reporter: at a single co-observed morning they are half their own record and half the population's, and by the eight mornings the design treats as real evidence they are eight ninths their own, which is the 'barely bites' the shrink is for. Borrowing tau_w = 4 instead would put a quarter of the population's disagreement onto a reporter with eight mornings of their own record, and would have forced the acceptance fixture to be widened until the constant cleared its bound -- which is the fixture serving the constant rather than the other way round.

AN HONEST REPORTER IS PULLED SLIGHTLY DOWN WHEN THE POPULATION CONTAINS A LIAR, and that is the shrink working, not a bug -- but it is bounded, and the bound is worth stating. D_r is measured on post-fence values, so no single reporter's D_r can exceed (2 * band width / sigma_eff)^2, about 11 for the widest band with two edges. With one liar among seven and three co-observed mornings an honest reporter keeps about 0.91 of their voice, and no arithmetic over fenced values can drive an honest reporter to the floor. Recorded because the unit generator, which has no fence in front of it, CAN reach that pathological world, and the property was written to allow it rather than to pretend it cannot happen.

FLAGGED, NOT FIXED: 06 section 4 says the reporter identity carrier is reporter_key and 'Never raw device counts', but G2's distinct-reporter count in this module still counts device_id. It is latent rather than wrong today -- no claim-merge path ships, so every reporter_key IS a device id and no stored number differs -- and re-keying a gate is not this step's criteria. Named here so the next step that touches G2 finds it.
acceptance: Two files' worth. chronic-disagreement-is-down-weighted-never-silenced.test.ts drives the real runLearningFitOnce port over twelve mornings at one spot: on the first eight, two honest people report head-to-overhead and one person claims ankle-to-knee, which is three device-samples, so the morning has a middle and a fence. THE ORACLE IS A MOVEMENT RATIO. Full trust is what the fit would store if concordance did not exist -- and because a weighted mean is unchanged when every weight is scaled by one number, 'everybody at full trust' is just the precision-weighted mean over the same post-fence values, which the test computes from the declared sigma_eff and the two band widths. That counterfactual was validated at RED: before this step existed the measured ratio came out at 0.9999999999999996, so the hand-computed oracle agrees with the shipped fit to fifteen digits. The second example is the newcomer guard: an agreeing community, one last morning seen differently from every other, reported once -- by a familiar face in one run and by a stranger in the other. The stored difference must be identical, because the only thing that can move it is the weight that morning carries.
unit_law: Five tests in tests/unit/learning-weight-laws.test.ts against concordanceWeightByReporter, whose exported signature is its port. (1) The floor and the ceiling over generated worlds, with a DELIBERATELY DRAWN extreme branch alongside the free one, because only an enormous disagreement reaches the floor and a free generator lands there too rarely to be evidence -- 03-04's lesson, applied. THE FLOOR AND CEILING ARE WRITTEN AS THE NUMBERS 06 STATES, not imported: see the falsifiability record. (2) A reporter nobody has ever co-observed keeps a full voice, generated against a community that disagrees loudly, so the branch is distinguishable from 'they happen to be handed a population mean of zero'. (3) MONOTONICITY: disagreeing more never buys a higher weight. (4) SYMMETRY: on a morning only two people saw, each is exactly as far from the other as the other is from them, so both must be weighed identically -- the property that forbids measuring against a median containing the reporter. (5) One example pinning the two constants: sqrt(tau_w) sigma of disagreement every morning is half a voice, and one co-observed morning two sigma out is exactly 0.6.
test_budget: Behaviours: (1) chronic disagreement is down-weighted inside a corridor and never silenced, (2) a reporter with no co-observation keeps a full voice, (3) the weight is monotone in disagreement, (4) a two-person disagreement is symmetric, (5) the formula's constants and units. Five behaviours, budget 10. Delivered 7: 2 acceptance examples and 5 unit tests.
red_evidence: The acceptance file was written first and run against the 04-02 body. RED with a semantic AssertionError: 'a reporter disagreeing every single morning still moved the stored difference 0.9999999999999996 of the way a believed reporter moves it, which is not under 0.6'. The newcomer guard passed on arrival, correctly, and had to: the roadmap records it as green at authoring and says it must stay green. The five unit tests were run against the absent function, then each was falsified by its own targeted mutation below rather than resting on that.
falsifiability_evidence: Four controlled mutations plus two re-checks of 04-02's, each planted alone against a byte-snapshot of src/learning, each reverted, the revert verified with diff -r ('REVERT CLEAN'), the suite re-run green. (P2) a reporter nobody co-observed handed the population's disagreement instead of a full voice: caught by the newcomer property. (P3) disagreement measured against a median that includes the reporter: caught by the symmetry property -- the mutation the leave-one-out reading exists to forbid. (P4) the shrink borrowing tau_w instead of its own strength: caught by the shrink pin, 0.6818181818181818 against the stated 0.6. (P1) THE FLOOR LOWERED TO ZERO -- A SHADOW BAN -- SURVIVED THE FIRST ROUND, and it is the finding of this step. The property asserted `weight >= CONCORDANCE_WEIGHT_FLOOR`, importing the same constant the production code reads, so lowering the constant lowered the assertion with it and the shadow ban passed. The floor and ceiling were rewritten as the literal 0.2 and 1.0 that 06 section 6.2 states verbatim; the mutation now fails with 'd_odd was weighed at 0.19999999999999996, under the 0.2 floor 06 section 6.2 states'. Re-checks after the restructure, because both live downstream of the new weighing order: (N2) the fence firing at two device-samples still fails 04-02's repaired below-three example, and (N3) fencing before collapsing still fails its ordering example.
test_repair: tests/acceptance/f-forecast-learns-from-the-beach/a-wild-claim-is-pulled-to-the-day-fence.test.ts's below-three example (landed 04-02) went red during this step, and its ORACLE was repaired -- never its claim, and never the production code. The old oracle read: a wild claim on a two-witness morning must store exactly what the same claim stores on a morning nobody else reported. That implication was sound only while the fence was the one stage that cared which morning a sample sat on. Concordance is a second such stage: in the two-witness run the two reporters co-observe each other and both earn a measured disagreement, while in the alone run neither does. The two runs now differ for a reason that has nothing to do with robustification, so the oracle could no longer support its conclusion. The claim -- below three device-samples nothing is robustified -- is unchanged and is now proven by the mirror of the example above it: over the SAME two claims, three witnesses must store the same number (the fence pulls one onto the other) and two witnesses must store different ones (nothing pulls anything). Mutation N2 confirms the repaired example still fires. This is the 'the test itself has a bug' case of the test-integrity rule, and it is recorded rather than quietly fixed.
